hypothesis: A fixed UTC first-hour opening range anchors new information to a calendar session rather than a rolling breakout/retest, reclaimed VWAP or EMA pullback. Its first strict directional break in the unchanged closed 4H trend may offer distinct entries. Test only this specification; no variants/grid/threshold fitting.

scanner_sha256.equivalence: Only exact published bytes plus one LF equal exact local bytes; no general whitespace normalization.

rules.clock: UTC 00:00-01:00 first four closed 15M bars define frozen high/low. No 15M break before 01:00. Do not select a best session or reanchor.
rules.trend: Exactly 180 contiguous closed 4H bars. Last close>EMA20>EMA50 LONG or strict inverse SHORT, same EMA implementation. No future/formed candles.
rules.confirmation: First strict boundary crossing each session/side: LONG previous close<=OR high, signal low<=OR high, signal close>OR high AND close>open. SHORT mirror at OR low. Consume that first crossing even if trend disagrees, structure or net room fails. Do not select a later crossing.
rules.stop: Frozen opposite opening-range edge minus .5 ATR14(15M) LONG or plus .5 ATR SHORT from exactly 180 fully closed bars at signal. Never change original 4H stop, shrink/widen after signal or force RR.
rules.target: Freeze fee/slippage-inclusive 2R target at confirmation-close limit price. Require inside prior 179 closed 15M highest high minus .25 ATR LONG or lowest low plus .25 ATR SHORT; exclude signal from room. Reject nonpositive or invalid range/target. No future maximum.
rules.identity: opening-range-v1:ticker:direction:UTC-session-start. Observe warmup from UTC day before period. Consume first crossing irrespective trend and pre-period. Any missing indicator point in a session suppresses subsequent entries of that session. Missing 00:00 first-hour bar invalidates range; no inferred history or rearm.
rules.pending: Exactly unchanged four-bar frozen limit evaluator. Before executable candle only prior closed windows; matching 4H trend, candle color, strict close beyond frozen OR break level, last-four low/high touch and SL validity. No expiration extension.
rules.chronology: signal close+1ms created_ms. Executable bar starts at signal close, exclude signal/prior bars. Unknown fill/any exit on fill bar AMBIGUOUS; subsequent TP/SL same bar AMBIGUOUS. Missing indicator/window/candle DATA_GAP, halt and retain uncertain cash. Adverse SL gap charged at worse open. Cutoff closed bars only.

decision.early_kill: Any complete registered period >=20 resolved with base AvgR<=1e-12 or PF<=1+1e-12: KILL_NO_LIVE_PROMOTION. Stop this model; leave unopened periods sealed. No retuning.
decision.historical_positive: Both historical_replication periods meeting every selection gate may only be a retrospective research candidate. They are previously viewed under other models; require both untouched future weeks and separately captured-live Shadow. No global optimum or production completion claim.
decision.future_positive: Both future_validation periods separately >=50 resolved and each selection gate; thereafter separate actual-observation Shadow resolved>=20, AvgR>0/PF>1, fee/capital/quality and execution evidence required for any promotion proposal. No automatic promotion.
decision.insufficient: No pooling development, weeks, daily reports, replay or live capture. Insufficient resolved count or partial periods remain INSUFFICIENT SAMPLE; never substitute a tuned variant.
decision.sequential: Process development, historical_replication_1, historical_replication_2, future_validation_1, future_validation_2 in that order. Reproduce original previous ledgers/sources before next period. Do not open next after KILL or quality mismatch.
decision.quality: All source/candle hashes and original first-entry control sets must reproduce. Any mismatch stops with BLOCKED_DATA_QUALITY and metrics/ROI null; no repaired prices/rows or replacing first archive. Indicator unavailable observations remain disclosed; fetch failures block qualification.

limitations: Historical development/replication market data previously viewed; reused research prices are not untouched independent confirmation or live samples.
Many failed hypotheses and correlated market events cause multiple-testing/selection bias; positive historical performance alone cannot prove optimality.
Fixed archived 182-market universe has listing/survivorship bias; disclose missing indicator windows and every market without outcome-based exclusions.
OHLC limit touch is hypothetical; funding, tick, depth, queue, liquidity and actual fills unverified.
Net R uses fee-inclusive stop-risk; MFE/MAE use price stop distance, neither is portfolio ROI.
Fixed research accounts are 10k USDC/1%/max3/total3%/1x/JST daily3%, unchanged. OPEN/AMBIGUOUS/DATA_GAP cash never released to create favorable ROI.
Existing KILL models, pending/VWAP protocols, collectors, production, UI, auth, notifications and account settings remain unchanged.
